title: Book Two · Chapter 92: The Water Below the Wall
story:
On Sunday, the family takes a walk near the river. They leave the blue bike at home. The path is busy. Mum wants to stop along the way when she likes.

Ronan carries a small packet of bread. Dad carries the water. Mum holds the bag with their cups inside. They find a dry place behind the low wall.

The river is brown after rain. Leaves move along its edge. Ronan leans toward the wall to see a small branch below.

“Stay on this side,” Dad says.

Ronan puts both feet back. From here, he can still see the branch. It catches on a stone. Then it turns and slips free.

“That is a boat,” he says.

“A poor one,” Dad says. “No seat.”

Mum sits on the low bench behind them. She opens the bread and divides it. Ronan takes his share. Then he watches the branch again. It moves slowly past a dark mark on the far wall.

Dad chooses another leaf in the water. “It will pass the branch,” he says. “It will get caught near the edge,” Ronan says. They stay in their safe place and watch.

The leaf turns twice. For a moment, it seems to stop. Then the water carries it past the branch and out toward the middle.

Dad raises one hand. “My leaf.”

“You did not make the water,” Ronan says.

“I chose a good leaf.”

Mum points to the bread in Ronan's hand. He has almost dropped it onto his shoe. He moves it back over the packet and takes a bite.

They sit for a while. Dad does not bring out a work card. Mum does not count customer hours. Ronan tells them about Jun's tiny book with big inside it. Dad asks if they can make a large book with small inside.

“Too much paper,” Mum says.

On the walk home, they pass a narrow place in the path. Ronan steps behind Mum to let another family pass. A little child waves at his bread packet. It is empty now. He waves back with his free hand.

At home, Ronan finds the wooden boat on the shelf. Its green ends are dry. He picks it up and turns it once. Then he puts it back on the shelf. His wooden boat can stay dry here.

He draws the branch in his own book instead. Dad's leaf is just ahead of it. This time, Ronan makes his branch a little longer. Dad looks over and notices at once. Ronan grins. He does not make the branch shorter.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

water＝水；wall＝矮墙；leaf＝叶子。

## 理解问题

1. 一家人怎样安全地看水？
2. Dad怎样参与普通快乐？

## 读句子

**Dad / carries / the water.** Dad／带着／水。
